shortBioEn: Queen of Kittur who led one of the earliest armed rebellions against British rule in 1824, decades before the 1857 uprising.
shortBioKn: 1824ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಶಸ್ತ್ರ ಬಂಡಾಯ ನಡೆಸಿದ ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ರಾಣಿ.
storyPagesEn: ["In the kingdom of Kittur lived a brave queen named Chennamma. She wore armour as easily as her crown. 👑","When the British East India Company tried to take Kittur using the Doctrine of Lapse, Queen Chennamma refused to bow down and said: 'Kittur belongs to us!'","In October 1824, Chennamma led her army against the British. 🏹 The British collector Thackeray was defeated and captured — a rare victory against the mighty British army!","The British returned with a larger army. Chennamma was imprisoned in Bailhongal Fort but her spirit never broke. She inspired everyone around her.","Kittur Chennamma became the first spark of the independence movement in Karnataka. 🌟 Her battle cry echoes through history.","Today her statue stands at Parliament in New Delhi. Every year on 23rd October, Karnataka celebrates Kittur Utsava in her honour! 🏰"]
storyPagesKn: ["ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಎಂಬ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ರಾಣಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು. 👑","ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಈಸ್ಟ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕಂಪನಿ ಕಿತ್ತೂರು ವಶಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಮುಂದಾದಾಗ, ರಾಣಿ ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ತಲೆ ಬಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.","1824ರ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಕಲೆಕ್ಟರ್ ತ್ಯಾಕರೇ ಸೋತು ಸೆರೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕ. 🏹","ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸೈನ್ಯ ತಂದರು. ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಬಂಧಿಯಾದರೂ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿ ನೀಡಿದಳು.","ಕಿತ್ತೂರು ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದ ಮೊದಲ ಕಿಡಿ. 🌟","ನವದೆಹಲಿ ಸಂಸತ್ ಮುಂದೆ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆ ನಿಂತಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ 23 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ ಕಿತ್ತೂರು ಉತ್ಸವ! 🏰"]

shortBioEn: Brave military commander of Kittur who continued guerrilla warfare against the British after Queen Chennamma was captured.
shortBioKn: ರಾಣಿ ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಸೆರೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ನಂತರ ಗೆರಿಲ್ಲಾ ಯುದ್ಧ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿದ ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ಶೂರ ಸೇನಾನಾಯಕ.
storyPagesEn: ["In Sangolli village near Kittur, a boy named Rayanna grew up dreaming of a free land. ⚔️ He was strong, fast, and fiercely loyal to his queen.","When Rayanna became military commander for Queen Chennamma, he proved himself in every battle. He was called a Tiger because of his fearless bravery!","After Queen Chennamma was captured, Rayanna took to the forests, launching surprise attacks on British supply lines at night. 🌙 The British couldn't catch him!","For nearly two years, his guerrilla warfare gave the British sleepless nights. He would strike at night and disappear like a ghost by dawn.","Finally a traitor betrayed him. Rayanna was captured and hanged on 26th January 1831. 🕯️","Today Sangolli Rayanna is remembered as the Robin Hood of Karnataka. His statue stands tall in Sangolli village as a guardian of freedom! 🌟"]
storyPagesKn: ["ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ಸಂಗೊಳ್ಳಿ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ನಾಡಿನ ಕನಸು ಕಾಣುತ್ತ ಬೆಳೆದ. ⚔️","ಸೇನಾಧಿಪತಿಯಾದ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಧೈರ್ಯ ತೋರಿ ಹುಲಿ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಸಿಕೊಂಡ.","ರಾಣಿ ಬಂಧಿಯಾದ ನಂತರ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ರಾತ್ರಿ ದಾಳಿ ನಡೆಸಿದ. 🌙","ಎರಡು ವರ್ಷ ರಾತ್ರಿ ದಾಳಿ, ಬೆಳ್ಳಂಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾಯ — ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರಿಗೆ ನಿದ್ದೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.","ಕೊನೆಗೆ ದ್ರೋಹಿ ಸ್ಥಳ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಟ್ಟ. 1831ರ ಜನವರಿ 26ರಂದು ನೇಣಿಗೇರಿಸಿದರು. 🕯️","ಇಂದು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ರಾಬಿನ್ ಹುಡ್ ಎಂದು ಸ್ಮರಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ಕಾವಲುಗಾರ! 🌟"]

shortBioEn: Karnataka's Rashtrakavi (National Poet) who wrote the state anthem 'Jaya Bharata Jananiya Tanujate' and received the Jnanpith Award.
shortBioKn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಕವಿ, ರಾಜ್ಯಗೀತೆ ರಚಯಿತ, ಜ್ಞಾನಪೀಠ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ವಿಜೇತ.
storyPagesEn: ["In the misty hills of Malnad, in a village called Kuppali, a boy named Venkatappa fell in love with nature. 🌿 The forests and rivers would fill every poem he later wrote.","Young Venkatappa walked miles to school daily, crossing streams and forests. He fell in love with Kannada literature and chose the pen name Kuvempu — from Ku-ppali Ve-nkatappa Pu-ttappa!","He studied and later taught at Mysore University. He wrote the epic Kannada poem Ramayana Darshanam — a true masterpiece of literature. 🎭","His most famous creation is the Karnataka State Anthem: Jaya Bharata Jananiya Tanujate! 🎵 Every Kannadiga sings this with pride. He wrote it for the 1956 unification of Karnataka.","Kuvempu believed every person is special — he called this Vishwamanava meaning Universal Human. He said: Be a world citizen, not just one religion or caste. 🌍","In 1988, Kuvempu received the Jnanpith Award — India's highest literary honour. He was given the title Rashtrakavi. His childhood home in Kuppali is now a museum! 🏡"]
storyPagesKn: ["ಮಲೆನಾಡಿನ ಕುಪ್ಪಳ್ಳಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೆಂಕಟಪ್ಪ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದ. 🌿","ಮೈಲುಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ನಡೆದು ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಯಾದ ವೆಂಕಟಪ್ಪ ಕುವೆಂಪು ಎಂದ.","ಮೈಸೂರು ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಓದಿ ಪ್ರಾಧ್ಯಾಪಕರಾಗಿ ರಾಮಾಯಣ ದರ್ಶನಂ ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯ ರಚಿಸಿದರು. 🎭","'ಜಯ ಭಾರತ ಜನನಿಯ ತನುಜಾತೆ!' ರಾಜ್ಯಗೀತೆ ರಚಿಸಿದರು. 🎵","'ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನವ' ತತ್ವ ಪ್ರಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕುವೆಂಪು ಜಾತಿ ಮೀರಿ ವಿಶ್ವ ಮಾನವನಾಗು ಎಂದರು. 🌍","1988ರಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ಞಾನಪೀಠ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಕವಿ ಬಿರುದು ಪಡೆದ ಕುವೆಂಪು ಕುಪ್ಪಳ್ಳಿ ಮನೆ ಇಂದು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಾಲಯ. 🏡"]

shortBioEn: 12th-century philosopher who founded the Lingayat movement and fought caste discrimination through Vachanas (spiritual poems).
storyPagesEn: ["In the 12th century when society was divided by caste, a young man named Basavanna decided to change everything. 🙏 He believed every person is equal before God.","Basavanna became minister in the court of King Bijjala in Kalyana. Instead of enjoying royal comforts, he spent his energy helping the poor and fighting caste discrimination.","He started the Anubhava Mantapa — a spiritual parliament! 🏛️ People of all castes sat TOGETHER and shared wisdom. This was revolutionary 900 years ago!","Basavanna wrote beautiful short poems called Vachanas in simple Kannada. His most famous teaching: Kayakave Kailasa — Work itself is heaven! Every honest job is sacred. 📖","He also introduced Dasoha — sharing your earnings. Give one third to yourself, one third to society, one third to God through service.","The Lingayat tradition has millions of followers today. Basavanna's statue stands at the UK Parliament — a Karnataka hero honoured by the world! 🌍"]
storyPagesKn: ["12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾತಿ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ ತುಂಬಿದ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಸವಣ್ಣ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲು ನಿಂತ. 🙏","ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ರಾಜ ಬಿಜ್ಜಳನ ಮಂತ್ರಿಯಾದ ಬಸವಣ್ಣ ಬಡವರ ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಧಾವಿಸಿದ.","'ಅನುಭವ ಮಂಟಪ' ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಜಾತಿ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹಂಚಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿದ. 🏛️","'ಕಾಯಕವೇ ಕೈಲಾಸ' ತತ್ವ ಸಾರಿ ಸರಳ ಕನ್ನಡ ವಚನ ರಚಿಸಿದ. 📖","'ದಾಸೋಹ' ತತ್ವ: ಗಳಿಕೆ ಮೂರನೇ ಒಂದು ತಮಗೆ, ಒಂದು ಸಮಾಜಕ್ಕೆ, ಒಂದು ಸೇವೆಗೆ.","ಬ್ರಿಟನ್ ಸಂಸತ್ ಮುಂದೆ ಬಸವಣ್ಣ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆ — ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹಿರಿಮೆ! 🌍"]

shortBioEn: India's greatest civil engineer, Diwan of Mysore (1912–1918), built the KRS Dam. His birthday 15th September is celebrated as National Engineer's Day.
shortBioKn: ಭಾರತದ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಸಿವಿಲ್ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್, ಮೈಸೂರು ದಿವಾನ್, KRS ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ.
statueLocation: KRS Dam Museum, Mandya District, Karnataka
storyPagesEn: ["In the village of Muddenahalli, a curious boy named Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya was born in 1860. ⚙️ He always asked why — why water flows, why bridges stand, how machines work.","When Hyderabad flooded every year, Visvesvaraya designed automatic flood gates that saved thousands of lives! The gates could open and close automatically to control water. A brilliant invention!","As Diwan of Mysore from 1912, he built schools, colleges, hospitals and industries. He said: Industrialise or Perish! 🏭 He wanted every Mysore citizen to have education and a job.","His greatest achievement was the Krishna Raja Sagar Dam on the Cauvery River, completed in 1931. 🌊 It was the largest reservoir in Asia at that time!","He was famous for honesty. He kept separate account books for government and personal expenses and never mixed them. He worked productively until age 100!","India celebrates 15th September as National Engineer's Day — his birthday. He received the Bharat Ratna in 1955. A true hero of modern India! ⭐"]
storyPagesKn: ["ಮುದ್ದೇನಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 1860ರಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಮೋಕ್ಷಗುಂಡಂ ಎಲ್ಲದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಾರಣ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದ. ⚙️","ಹೈದರಾಬಾದ್ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಗೇಟ್ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಸಾಹಸ ತೋರಿದರು.","1912ರಿಂದ ಮೈಸೂರು ದಿವಾನ್ ಆಗಿ ಶಾಲೆ, ಕಾಲೇಜು, ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು. 🏭","ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿ ಮೇಲೆ KRS ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು 1931ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣ — ಆಗ ಏಷ್ಯಾದ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಜಲಾಶಯ! 🌊","ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕ ಮೇಧಾವಿ: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಖರ್ಚಿಗೆ ಬೇರೆ ಲೆಕ್ಕ. 100 ವರ್ಷ ತನಕ ಕೆಲಸ!","ಪ್ರತಿ 15 ಸೆಪ್ಟೆಂಬರ್ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಇಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ದಿನ. 1955ರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ ರತ್ನ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ. ⭐"]

shortBioEn: Founder of Bengaluru city in 1537. Built the original city with four watchtowers and planned it as a model settlement for the people.
shortBioKn: 1537ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಗೋಪುರಗಳಿಂದ ನಗರ ಗಡಿ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ಆದರ್ಶ ನಗರ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ.
storyPagesEn: ["Over 480 years ago, where today's Bengaluru stands, there were only forests and villages. A chieftain named Kempegowda looked at this land and said: I will build a great city here! 🏙️","In 1537, Kempegowda received permission from the Vijayanagara Empire. He chose the land wisely — good water, favourable climate, and a strategic location on the Deccan Plateau.","Kempegowda built a mud fort at the centre, laid streets in a grid, created markets called pete, and built water tanks called kere. His city planning was remarkable for his time! 🗺️","To mark city boundaries, Kempegowda built four tall watchtowers — one at each corner. These Kempegowda Towers still exist today in different parts of Bengaluru!","He was not just a builder but a kind ruler. He built temples, encouraged trade, and ensured all communities lived in harmony. This city belongs to everyone was his spirit!","Today the largest airport in South India — Kempegowda International Airport — bears his name. In 2022 a 108 foot golden statue was unveiled there! 🌟"]
storyPagesKn: ["480 ವರ್ಷ ಹಿಂದೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಿದ್ದವು. ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ ಮಹಾ ನಗರ ಕಟ್ಟಲು ನಿಂತ. 🏙️","1537ರಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ ಅನುಮತಿ ಪಡೆದ ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ ನೀರು, ಹವಾಮಾನ, ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ ಜಾಗ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ.","ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಕೋಟೆ, ಬೀದಿ ಯೋಜನೆ, ಪೇಟೆ, ಕೆರೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ. ಆ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ನಗರ ಯೋಜನೆ! 🗺️","ನಾಲ್ಕು ಮೂಲೆ ಗೋಪುರ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ ನಗರ ಗಡಿ ಗುರುತಿಸಿದ. ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ ಗೋಪುರ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು.","ದೇವಾಲಯ ಕಟ್ಟಿ, ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸಿ, ಸಮಾಜ ಸಾಮರಸ್ಯ ಕಾಪಾಡಿದ ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ.","ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿಮಾನ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ಅವರ ಹೆಸರು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. 2022ರಲ್ಲಿ 108 ಅಡಿ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆ ಅನಾವರಣ! 🌟"]

shortBioEn: The first Indian queen to resist Portuguese colonial rule. Rani Abbakka of Ullal successfully repelled multiple Portuguese attacks along the Tulu Nadu coast.
shortBioKn: ಪೋರ್ಚುಗೀಸ್ ವಸಾಹತು ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸಿದ ಭಾರತದ ಮೊದಲ ರಾಣಿ.
storyPagesEn: ["Long before 1857, on the beautiful Tulu Nadu coast, warrior queen Abbakka ruled the port town of Ullal. 🛡️ Trained from childhood in warfare, archery, and statecraft.","The Portuguese wanted to control the spice trade. They demanded tribute from Ullal. Queen Abbakka's answer was simple: Come and fight! ⚔️","In 1555 the Portuguese attacked with powerful warships. Abbakka launched a counter-attack at night! The Portuguese Admiral was captured. A stunning victory! 🚢","The Portuguese attacked again and again. Each time Abbakka gathered her allies and fought back. Her naval guerrilla tactics made her legendary.","Abbakka was finally betrayed by her own husband who sided with the Portuguese. She was captured but fought even her captors, sword in hand. 🌊","Today Rani Abbakka is celebrated as Abhaya Rani — the Fearless Queen. The Indian Coast Guard named a ship after her. Her statue faces the sea at Ullal beach! 🌟"]
storyPagesKn: ["1857ಕ್ಕೂ ಮೊದಲು ತುಳು ನಾಡಿನ ಉಳ್ಳಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಬ್ಬಕ್ಕ ಎಂಬ ವೀರ ರಾಣಿ ಆಳ್ತಿದ್ದಳು. 🛡️","ಮಸಾಲೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದ ಪೋರ್ಚುಗೀಸರಿಗೆ ಅಬ್ಬಕ್ಕ ನೇರ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು. ⚔️","1555ರಲ್ಲಿ ರಾತ್ರಿ ನೌಕಾ ದಾಳಿಯಿಂದ ಅಡ್ಮಿರಲ್ ಸೆರೆ ಹಿಡಿದಳು. 🚢","ಮಿತ್ರ ಸೇನೆ ಕೂಡಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಪೋರ್ಚುಗೀಸರ ಸೋಲಿಸಿದಳು.","ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಸ್ವಂತ ಗಂಡ ದ್ರೋಹ ಮಾಡಿ ಪೋರ್ಚುಗೀಸರಿಗೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಟ್ಟ. ಖಡ್ಗ ಹಿಡಿದೇ ಹೋರಾಡಿದಳು. 🌊","'ಅಭಯ ರಾಣಿ' ಎಂದು ಗೌರವಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವ ಅಬ್ಬಕ್ಕ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮೊದಲ ನೌಕಾ ವೀರ. ಉಳ್ಳಾಲ ಕಡಲಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಮೆ ನಿಂತಿದೆ. 🌟"]

shortBioEn: 12th-century Kannada mystic poet and Bhakti saint who wrote powerful Vachanas and challenged social norms by living a life of complete spiritual freedom.
shortBioKn: 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಂತ ಕವಯಿತ್ರಿ, ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ವಚನಗಳ ರಚಯಿತ.
storyPagesEn: ["In the 12th century, a girl born in the Shivamogga region had a heart burning with devotion to Shiva. 🌸 Her name was Akkamahadevi. From childhood she felt God alone was her true companion.","Against her wishes she was married to King Kausika. But Akkamahadevi's heart belonged to Chenna Mallikarjuna. She left the palace giving up royal comforts to seek a life of pure devotion.","Akkamahadevi walked village to village singing Vachanas — powerful spiritual poems in Kannada. Her words were so beautiful and deep that people wept when they heard them. 📖","She reached the Anubhava Mantapa started by Basavanna and debated with the greatest scholars. She said: One who sees me is blind. One who cannot see God everywhere is truly naked. 🌟","Her Vachanas are full of devotion and fearless independence. She addressed Shiva as Chenna Mallikarjuna. Over 400 of her Vachanas survive as timeless poetry.","Akkamahadevi broke every social barrier 900 years ago. She is a symbol of spiritual courage and women's independence. Thousands of Karnataka schools are named after her! 💫"]
storyPagesKn: ["12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಶಿವಮೊಗ್ಗ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿವಭಕ್ತಿಯ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಜನಿಸಿದಳು. 🌸 ಅವಳೇ ಅಕ್ಕಮಹಾದೇವಿ.","ರಾಜ ಕೌಶಿಕನ ಜೊತೆ ವಿವಾಹ ಒಪ್ಪದ ಅಕ್ಕ ಅರಮನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಭಕ್ತಿ ಹಾದಿ ಹಿಡಿದಳು.","ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ತಿರುಗಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ವಚನ ಹಾಡಿದಳು. ಅವಳ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಜನ ಕಣ್ಣೀರು ಸುರಿಸಿದರು. 📖","ಅನುಭವ ಮಂಟಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರ ಜೊತೆ ಚರ್ಚೆ ಮಾಡಿದಳು. 🌟","ಚೆನ್ನ ಮಲ್ಲಿಕಾರ್ಜುನನ ಮೇಲೆ 400ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವಚನ ರಚಿಸಿದ ಅಕ್ಕ ಭಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ಸಂಕೇತ.","900 ವರ್ಷ ಹಿಂದೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಅಡ್ಡಗಟ್ಟೆ ಮುರಿದ ಅಕ್ಕ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ಸಂಕೇತ. 💫"]

shortBioEn: The Tiger of Mysore who fought four major wars against the British East India Company and introduced the world's first war rocket.
shortBioKn: ಮೈಸೂರು ಹುಲಿ, ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಯುದ್ಧ ನಡೆಸಿ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಮೊದಲ ಯುದ್ಧ ರಾಕೆಟ್ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ.
storyPagesEn: ["In 1750, a boy born in Devanahalli would one day be called the Tiger of Mysore. 🐯 His name was Tippu Sultan. From childhood he trained in warfare, languages and statecraft.","Tippu Sultan invented iron-cased war rockets — the first in the world! The Mysorean rockets terrified British armies. They were later studied by William Congreve to develop British rockets. 🚀","He fought four major wars against the British, Marathas and Nizam. In the Second Anglo-Mysore War he completely defeated the British general Braithwaite!","Tippu Sultan was also a great administrator. He encouraged silk weaving in Mysore — the silk industry we still know today! He built canals, planted avenue trees and introduced a new calendar. 🌿","In 1799 a massive coalition attacked Srirangapatna. Outnumbered and betrayed by his general Mir Sadiq, Tippu refused to surrender. He died fighting at the Water Gate, sword in hand. 🗡️","His famous words live on: Better to live one day as a tiger than a thousand years as a sheep. His rockets are in museums in London and Mysuru. He is Karnataka's ultimate warrior hero! 🌟"]
storyPagesKn: ["1750ರಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವನಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಟಿಪ್ಪು ಮೈಸೂರು ಹುಲಿ ಎಂದು ಜಗತ್ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧನಾದ. 🐯","ಕಬ್ಬಿಣ ರಾಕೆಟ್ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ ಟಿಪ್ಪು — ವಿಶ್ವದ ಮೊದಲ ಯುದ್ಧ ರಾಕೆಟ್! ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಸೇನೆ ಭಯಭೀತರಾದರು. 🚀","ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಯುದ್ಧ ನಡೆಸಿದ. 2ನೇ ಆಂಗ್ಲೋ-ಮೈಸೂರು ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸೋಲಿಸಿದ!","ಮೈಸೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ನೇಕಾರಿಕೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸಿದ, ಕಾಲುವೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ, ಹೊಸ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿದ. 🌿","1799ರಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೀರಂಗಪಟ್ಟಣ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ರೋಹ ಎದುರಿಸಿ ಟಿಪ್ಪು ಶರಣಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಖಡ್ಗ ಹಿಡಿದೇ ವೀರ ಮರಣ. 🗡️","'ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಹುಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಬದುಕು ಸಾವಿರ ವರ್ಷ ಕುರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬದುಕುವುದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಲೇಸು.' 🌟"]

shortBioEn: Philosopher-saint who fought caste discrimination with the motto: One Caste, One Religion, One God for Humanity.
shortBioKn: 'ಒಂದು ಜಾತಿ ಒಂದು ಧರ್ಮ ಒಂದು ದೇವ ಮಾನವನಿಗೆ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ವ ಸಾರಿ ಜಾತಿ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ ವಿರೋಧಿಸಿದ ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ.
storyPagesEn: ["In the 19th century society was deeply divided by caste. People from certain communities could not enter temples, use public roads or get education. ☮️ A great soul named Narayana Guru rose to change all of this.","Born near Thiruvananthapuram in 1856, Narayana Guru was deeply learned in Sanskrit, Tamil and Malayalam. He was a poet, philosopher and mystic who felt great pain seeing people discriminated by birth.","His most powerful act: he consecrated temples open to ALL people regardless of caste. When upper-caste leaders protested he said: I consecrate not a Hindu temple but a Human Temple! 🛕","His motto rings through history: One Caste, One Religion, One God for Humanity. He met Mahatma Gandhi who was deeply inspired by his teachings.","Narayana Guru established schools, libraries and hostels for suppressed communities. He believed education was the true path to equality. 📚","His influence spread across Kerala and Karnataka's coastal region. He is worshipped as a saint and social revolutionary — a beacon of equality for humanity! 🌟"]
storyPagesKn: ["19ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾತಿ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು. ನಾರಾಯಣ ಗುರು ಎಲ್ಲ ಬದಲಿಸಲು ಹೊರಟರು. ☮️","1856ರಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ನಾರಾಯಣ ಗುರು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ, ತಮಿಳು, ಮಲಯಾಳ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಗಳಿಸಿ ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ, ಕವಿ ಆದರು.","ಎಲ್ಲ ಜಾತಿ ಜನರಿಗೆ ತೆರೆದ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆ ಮಾಡಿ 'ಇದು ಮಾನವ ದೇವಾಲಯ!' ಎಂದರು. 🛕","'ಒಂದು ಜಾತಿ ಒಂದು ಧರ್ಮ ಒಂದು ದೇವ ಮಾನವನಿಗೆ' — ಮಹಾತ್ಮ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಕೂಡ ಪ್ರೇರಿತರಾದರು.","ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ, ಗ್ರಂಥಾಲಯ, ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ನಿಲಯ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಸಮಾನತೆಯ ದಾರಿ ಎಂದರು. 📚","ಕೇರಳ ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಕರಾವಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರಿದ ನಾರಾಯಣ ಗುರು ಸಮಾನತೆಯ ಬೆಳಕು. 🌟"]
